g.title: flow
g.text: Core ↔ Backend cache + component OVERVIEW — two columns, who-calls-who (2026-07-06)

LEFT=CORE (yadgar/, SHIPPED core Cache #164) · RIGHT=BACKEND (yadgar/backend/, recall pipeline + NEW backend Cache) · TWO separate caches (one per service, they never merge) · ONLY 2 signals cross the boundary: recall() HTTP POST (solid) + data_epoch (async dashed)

g.title: cluster_core
g.text: CORE (yadgar/, --cpus 1) — MCP tools + forwarder + SHIPPED unified Cache (yadgar/cache.py #164) + data_epoch bus

g.title: cluster_backend
g.text: BACKEND (yadgar/backend/, --cpus 2) — backend.recall pipeline + NEW unified Cache (yadgar/backend/cache.py) + ML + DB
